notes.title: Sacred Stone v1.1 – The Major Update Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers of Sacred Stone, greetings!

It’s been a while! After a long period of dedicated development, we are finally ready to bring you this “Major Update”!
This update is packed with exciting new features and long-awaited improvements, aiming to give you a whole new adventure experience!

Without further ado, let’s take a look at what’s new!


✨ Adventure Optimization – A Huge Upgrade in Experience! ✨
Multilingual Support: English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese have been added, making it easier for more adventurers to enjoy!

Customizable Controls: The brand-new \[Key Binding] feature is here! Freely set up the most comfortable control scheme that suits your style.

Controller Shortcuts: Optimized for controller users—open maps, attribute allocation, and other functions with a single button!

Pet Equipment Unlock: Certain equipment can now be equipped by pets, making your companions stronger than ever!

Sacred Rock Weapon Improvement: Instead of one out of six at random, three weapons will now be randomly selected for you to choose from—making it much easier to get your favorite weapon!

Adventurer Hiring Optimization: Adventurers you’ve already hired will no longer appear in the list, helping you find new teammates more easily!

Map Decoration Adjustments: Some scenery and decorations have been updated—keep an eye out for subtle changes during your journey!


📖 Brand-New Content – Explore Even Further! 📖
\[Encyclopedia] System: A full record of monsters you’ve encountered, weapons and items you’ve collected, and all kinds of status effects. Your ultimate guide to the world of Sacred Stone!

Battle Interface Enhancement: Combat experience has been upgraded! You can now view your party members’ status during battle, and after combat ends, you’ll see the \[Total Damage] dealt—helping you plan tactics with more precision!


🎁 Major Update Celebration – Log In to Claim Your Rewards! 🎁
To celebrate this important update, we’ve prepared a special gift for all players! Log in after the update to receive:

Medium HP Potion x10

Medium MP Potion x10

Medium Stamina Potion x10

And a brand-new piece of equipment: \[Ring of Passion]!

The \[Ring of Passion] will greatly enhance all your attributes (Attack, Defense, Agility, Luck, etc.), making it the perfect support for your journey into the unknown!

※ Please collect the rewards from the chest in front of your house.


💡 Gratitude & Future Outlook
We sincerely thank you for your continuous support and valuable feedback for Sacred Stone!
It is your encouragement that drives us to keep improving and adding more content.

We hope this major update brings you an even better gameplay experience. If you encounter any issues after the update, or if you have suggestions for future content, feel free to share them with us in the Steam Community Hub!

The adventure in Sacred Stone continues, and we look forward to meeting you in the game!

Happy adventuring!


\[DestroyGeneration] 傑尼Jenne
